ronald-acuna-jr.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
ronald-acuna-jr.status: Rehabbing from Hamstring Strain — Return Expected ~July 18, 2025

current_injury.type: Grade 1 left hamstring strain (2nd occurrence this season)
current_injury.details: Strained left hamstring on June 10, placed on 10-day IL. Second occurrence this season (first was May 2025). Limited to 53 games at time of latest report, hitting .251/.373/.421 with 7 HR, 31 R, 22 RBI, 15 SB. Began Minor League rehab assignment in Florida Complex League mid-July 2025 (went 0-for-3 with a strikeout). Manager Walt Weiss: 'will likely begin a Minor League rehab assignment during the All-Star break.' Return expected when Braves resume play Friday vs Rangers.
current_injury.rehab_timeline: FCL rehab started mid-July 2025; return expected ~July 18, 2025 at earliest

injury_history.details: Grade 1 left hamstring strain. On 10-day IL since June 10. Began FCL rehab mid-July. 2nd occurrence this season. Home Run Derby availability in jeopardy per FantraxHQ (Jul 9, 2025).
First hamstring strain this season. Missed time but returned before June 10 strain.
Torn meniscus requiring surgery. Raised long-term concerns about clutch-play dominance.
Torn ACL during a game vs. Mets. Missed ~8 months. Iconic comeback from devastating injury (2023 NL MVP).
injury_history.return_status: Returned and back to MVP form

injury_history.details: Bone bruise and contusion to the left knee. Missed time but recovered.

rehab_timeline.progress: Cleared for MiLB rehab. Began FCL assignment going 0-for-3. Must progress: FCL rehab → MLB activation. Home Run Derby availability may be in jeopardy.

ronald-acuna-jr.notes: First injury-shortened 2025 season since 2023 (torn ACL). Recurring hamstring issues this season (2 occurrences). Pre-injury 2025 slash line was .251/.373/.421 at time of latest report. Community should monitor Braves beat reporters (Mark Bowman, Journal Sentinel) for Rehab Gate updates. The 2025 fibula fracture history and knee issues are cumulative concerns. Home Run Derby status is uncertain as of July 9, 2025.

mookie-betts.name: Mookie Betts
mookie-betts.status: Active — Returned from IL (Oblique Strain Resolved)

current_injury.type: Right oblique strain (resolved — returned to lineup July 2025)
current_injury.details: Placed on 10-day IL with right oblique strain ~5 weeks before return. Activated ahead of Monday night's series opener vs. Giants. Hit 2-for-5 with a walk and played 11 innings in the field in two rehab games with Triple-A Oklahoma City. Initial plan: play Mon/Tue, day off Wed, then 2 of next 3. Was batting 2nd against Giants, moved back to No. 2 spot (his primary spot in 2024). Kyle Tucker moved to cleanup, Freddie Freeman moved to 2nd spot behind Shohei Ohtani. Betts: 'I know I'm not the hero. It's going to take us all.' Roberts: 'I like breaking up Freddie and Shohei.'
current_injury.rehab_timeline: Rehab completed July 2025. Regular season return July 2025.

injury_history.details: Placed on 10-day IL. 5+ week absence. Activated in July 2025 after two rehab games with OKC. Returned to No. 2 spot in lineup. Left oblique strain in early July caused lineup removal and a stint on IL.
Severe illness causing significant weight loss (~20 lbs in two weeks). Also death of stepfather. Most tumultuous period in recent memory.
Broken right wrist during batting practice at Camelback Ranch (pitching machine freak accident). Sidelined 6-8 weeks.
Sprained left ankle. Managed with treatment and load management.

rehab_timeline.notes: 5-week DL stint with oblique strain completed. 2 Minor League rehab games in OKC. Returned to everyday lineup. Conservative load management: 3-game stretch then rest day.

mookie-betts.return_status: Active - Returned from IL. Playing in lineup on regular schedule with load management. No IL expected currently.
mookie-betts.notes: Betts' 2025 has been tumultuous — broken wrist, oblique strain, severe illness, personal loss. All major injuries resolved as of latest. Dodgers now have two stars returning (Snell debuted Saturday, Betts activated Monday). Lineup shuffle: Freeman back to 2nd, Tucker to 4th, Betts to 3. Betts on 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15 games).
data_sources: MLB.com Mookie Betts returning from IL

freddie-freeman.name: Freddie Freeman

current_injury.type: Left rib/scar tissue disruption (March 2025 Tokyo opener)
current_injury.details: Scratched from first regular-season game at Tokyo Dome vs. Chicago Cubs with left rib discomfort/scar tissue. Roberts said 'thought was scar tissue broke up during BP.' Freeman said '75% chance of playing tomorrow.' Played through the discomfort in subsequent games. Chronic left ankle from June 2025 sprain managed with treatment. No acute injury currently preventing play.
current_injury.severity: Mild (resolved rib issue) / Moderate (chronic ankle managed)
current_injury.rehab_timeline: No active rehab. Rib issue resolved quickly. Chronic ankle managed with load management and occasional treatment.

injury_history.details: Re-aggravated during BP for Tokyo Dome debut vs Cubs. Scratched from first regular-season game at Tokyo. Roberts: 'thought was scar tissue broke up during BP.' Freeman: '75% chance of playing tomorrow.'
injury_history.return_status: Returned - played through discomfort after Tokyo opener

injury_history.details: Sprained right ankle late in regular season. Underwent debridement + loose body removal (Dec 2024). Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 World Series despite injury.

rehab_timeline.notes: No active rehab. Rib scar tissue issue resolved quickly. Chronic ankle managed with load management. Freeman moved to 2nd spot in lineup behind Ohtani after Betts' return.

freddie-freeman.return_status: N/A - Currently active and playing regularly. No acute injury preventing play.
freddie-freeman.notes: Wrapped 2024 WS with Walk-Off Grand Slam despite ankle injury. Rib/scar tissue issue caused Tokyo opener scratch but resolved quickly. Chronic ankle issues (right debridement Dec 2024, left sprain Jun 2025) require ongoing monitoring. 2025 season: softball grounds leading MLB, 30 SB in first 300 ABs, walking at 25.9% clip.

metadata.contribution_guidelines: Fork repository, create feature branch, update injury-updates.json and/or LATEST-INFO.md, submit PR with date, details, rehab timeline, return status, and source URL. Cross-reference with official sources (MLB.com, team PRs, beat reporters).

Freddie Freeman — Left rib/scar tissue scratch from 2025 Tokyo opener (March 18, 2025), currently active. Historical injury history preserved from full file version.
